REQUEST TEST: CBC (Complete Blood Count) with differential, LFTs (Liver Function Tests), LDH (Lactate Dehydrogenase), and ESR (Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate).

The CBC results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index strongly suggest a B-cell lymphoma. Given your enlarged supraclavicular node and B-symptoms (night sweats, weight loss), are you experiencing any pain in the lymph node area after exercise, or have you noticed any skin changes or abdominal masses?

REQUEST IMAGES: CT Abdomen and Pelvis, CT Chest.
DIAGNOSIS READY: B-Cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma).
